items.source_evidence: After simplifying div/rem(select(cond,0,Y)), scans earlier instructions in the same block until a non-returning instruction and replaces all uses of the divisor select with Y and of its condition with the proven boolean, enqueueing each changed instruction.
items.disposition: this is a concrete context-sensitive multi-use IR rewrite, not analysis-only. The current analysis-helper kind and empty rewrite-opcode list understate the outcome; recommend a distinct rewrite or mutation record with exact per-use scope. Its nonlocal use/CFG requirement can remain the blocker.
items.coordinator_resolution: Applied: classified as mutation and described arbitrary earlier same-block instruction operand substitutions and exact traversal stops; no newly constructed opcode.

Confirm the add/mul records or this helper explicitly account for the multi-use trunc/mask outputs and the root icmp replacement.
items.coordinator_resolution: Applied: explicit trunc user mutation and and/zext reconstruction recorded in shared postlude and referenced by the add/mul outcomes.
